note: A control mapping is meaningful only against a known revision. Every source here is pinned by digest or recorded as unavailable with the reason. An unresolved source is never silently substituted with a newer release. Retrieval and rendering of the DISA sources are owned by datopsis/container-hardening; this register records the identity this repository maps against.

sources.license: US Government work; redistribution terms stated in the package
sources.notes: Applies to the host and to the UBI 9 filesystem. Most of its rules are host-owned rather than image-owned, which the origination property records per control.

sources.title: Container Platform Security Requirements Guide
sources.license: US Government work; redistribution terms stated in the package
sources.notes: Governs the platform that runs containers rather than an image, so most of it originates as host-inherited here. 188 rules: 8 CAT I, 177 CAT II, 3 CAT III. Retrieval and rendering are owned by datopsis/container-hardening, which holds the rendered catalogue one file per rule; consume it from there rather than from the DISA download index, which is a JavaScript-rendered portal that cannot be scraped. The URL and digest above record the upstream identity the rendering derives from.

sources.title: Application Server Security Requirements Guide
sources.license: US Government work; redistribution terms stated in the package
sources.notes: Retrieved and pinned, then assessed as not applicable to this component; see docs/adr/0010-application-server-srg-not-applicable.md. Of its 137 rules, 27 presuppose a management interface or hosted applications and 18 refer to accounts. This image has no management interface, no accounts, and hosts no application, so those rules govern objects that do not exist here; the remainder are stated for a component of this kind by the Web Server SRG, which is the applicable DISA cross-reference. Pinned rather than dropped so the determination is tied to the revision it was made against. The applicability determination is the worked example carried into datopsis/container-hardening, which owns retrieval and rendering of this source.

sources.license: CIS Securesuite / CIS Benchmark terms; redistribution restricted
sources.notes: Retrieval requires an authenticated CIS Workbench account; the public URL redirects to a login. The benchmark text also may not be redistributed, so it can be cited by identifier but its content cannot be vendored or quoted at length. Pinning by digest requires an account holder to retrieve it and record the digest here.
